utterances.text: Hey Grandpa, how's your day going?
Oh dear, I think you meant 'brake' instead of 'break'. It's important to use the right words, especially when driving.
Oh, thanks for pointing that out! I'll be more careful with my words.
You're welcome, dear. Always happy to help you learn.
Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your help.
Be careful and make sure you're not speeding, dear.
I will, Grandma. Thanks for the reminder!
I trust you, dear, but I just want to make sure you're safe. It's my job to worry a little.
I know, Grandma. I promise I'll be careful. Love you!
Alright, dear, I understand. Just keep focusing on the road and drive safely.
I will, Grandma. Thanks for always looking out for me.
Because I care about you and want to make sure you're safe, dear.
I know, and I appreciate it. I'll call you once I get there safely.
Oh, I see! Well, I'm glad you're keeping things light-hearted.
